title: Store choice receivers
description: The members a refinery pickup's store lines may book onto: the member, and for a Logistician the members of the units they are a Logistician of, without those who withhold their name; the member first, then the others by name. Each with the org units they directly belong to.

ref.description: The member's pseudonym at this client, as a store line's receiver names it. Opaque.

name.description: The name the Basetool shows for the member.

self.description: Whether this is the member the request acts for.

orgUnits.description: The org units the receiver directly belongs to.
